card.name: Emotive -ing adjectives like sobering, promising
card.fires_on: The -ing ending of evaluative adjectives such as sobering, promising, appalling, depressing, and whole words like disturbing and chilling. It fires when the adjective describes news, an example, a precedent, or a target.

modes.label: Split -ing endings
modes.description: The -ing or -ressing ending after a partial word like sober, Prom, app, or Dep.
modes.example: A sober<<ing>> example of growing tension in Sino-A

modes.label: Whole adjectives
modes.description: A complete emotive adjective such as disturbing or chilling before a noun or clause.

card.plain: It marks feeling-laden descriptive words like sobering, promising or disturbing, especially where they finish a split word.
